chapter: Solo years, marriages and the Canadian party
title: His mother and the father's blessing that ended it
summary: His mother liked her but could not see the marriage, and he used the need to ask her father as grounds not to marry.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Did your mother meet her, by the way?

I think my mother did. See, I had a picture of her -- I think my mother met her. But I had a picture of her that was the last word. However, my mother met her and my mother liked her but my mother couldn't see me marrying her then, that's all, she couldn't see that. But I couldn't see me not marrying her. But I didn't, only on account of that mess she gave me about her father. I'm sorry that I didn't marry her. I would have married her instead of the other girl. See, I picked the wrong way 'cause I got a prostitute when I married the other girl.
The message that she gave you from her father was what?

I had to ask her father to marry her. That's the message. I don't want to ask her father because I don't think her father would have said so. So I don't ask him. But I used that for the grounds that we don't get married.
